summary: Enhance your career with our Maritime Logistics and Supply Chain Training Course. Gain essential skills and knowledge for success in the maritime industry.
lede: Maritime logistics training covers how sea-freight shipments move through planning, documentation, port and clearance processes, and inland transport. It is for logistics, procurement, shipping, and trade professionals who need to manage shipments predictably and control total costs. Learners practise selecting Incoterms and routes, preparing shipping documents, and managing landed costs, delays, and forwarder performance.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals across sectors who manage sea freight operations and need to optimize maritime logistics processes.
audience: Operations managers dependent on timely inbound cargo
modules: Maritime Logistics Fundamentals and End-to-End Flow
Incoterms and Contracting for Sea Freight
Freight Planning, Routing, and Carrier Selection
Understanding Landed Cost and Charge Drivers
Customs and Trade Compliance in Daily Practice
Managing Demurrage, Detention, and Dispute Avoidance
Risk Management and Contingency Planning for Sea Freight
Performance Management for Forwarders, Carriers, and Suppliers
Digital Tools and Visibility for Maritime Logistics
Communicating and Defending Maritime Logistics Decisions
prerequisites: To benefit from this course, participants should have a foundational understanding of supply chain and logistics principles, as well as basic knowledge of international trade and import/export processes.
